tagline: Everything We Do Starts with Chemistry with a Purpose
hero_kpi_rationale: Operating margin is the key KPI as it reflects successful transformation toward profitable growth despite challenging markets, and demonstrates structural improvement in a mature industrial sector.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Share of profit on sales after production costs and general expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin reaches a record level of 19.7% in 2023, supported by efficiency gains and a more profitable product mix.
kpis.signal: Historical record despite declining demand in paper.

kpis.name: Operating EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Gross operating result before depreciation and exceptional items.
kpis.description: Operating EBITDA stands at 667 M€ in 2023, a historical peak, driven by resilience in the Industry & Water segment.
kpis.signal: Record level in 2023 despite challenging market conditions.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people working in the company.
kpis.description: Kemira employs approximately 5,000 employees in 2023, a stable workforce supporting its global operations.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount reflecting an optimized organization.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin is not explicitly mentioned in the 2023 report.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical assets such as plants or equipment.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are not specified in the provided excerpts.

kpis.name: R&D spending as a percentage of revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development spending in revenue.
kpis.description: The R&D to revenue ratio is not mentioned in the 2023 report.

risks.title: Dependence on renewable raw materials and price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified at the outset of Item 1A as critical to operational capacity. Direct language on 'availability and price of renewable materials'. Trend stable but structural to growth strategy in renewable solutions. High weight in double materiality (Resource use and circular economy score 4/5).

risks.title: Chemical regulatory compliance and substance safety
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as major risk affecting 'ability to consistently provide products and services that meet customer and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements'. Language of moderate intensity but strict regulatory context (ISO Standards, CSRD). Trend up with CSRD compliance 2024. Significant weight (Safety, Substances of very high concern identified as top material topics).

risks.title: Supply chain management and supplier risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly addressed via 'Suppliers' sustainability performance may impact our operational efficiency and business risks'. Language of moderate intensity but active engagement (EcoVadis audits, Code of Conduct). Trend stable but growing importance. Significant weight in materiality (Business conduct, Sustainable supply chain identified).

risks.title: Energy transition and decarbonized energy costs
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in double materiality (Climate change score 5/5, GHG emissions Scope 1&2 reduction target 50% by 2030). Language of moderate intensity but ambitious target and Science-Based Targets commitment 2022. Trend up with energy transition. Critical weight for energy-intensive manufacturing operations.

risks.title: Water management and regulatory compliance on water and wastewater
risks.score_rationale: Identified as TOP MATERIAL TOPIC (Water score 5/5 in double-materiality). Language of very high intensity: 'water is still one of the most important topics' and 'well-aligned with our strategic ambitions'. Trend stable but growing importance. Critical weight: core business (water-intensive industries, drinking and wastewater solutions).

risks.title: Competition and sustainable product differentiation
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in growth strategy for renewable solutions (500M€ renewable solutions revenue growth target by 2030). Language of moderate intensity but competitive context in chemical market. Trend up with customer transition toward sustainability. Moderate weight: dependent on R&D capacity and innovation.

risks.title: Worker safety and health (TRIFR, critical incidents)
risks.score_rationale: Identified as TOP MATERIAL TOPIC (Safety score 4/5, Working conditions for own workforce and value chain). Language of moderate intensity but ambitious KPI (TRIFR 1.5 by 2025, top 10% industry by 2030). Trend stable but growing importance. Significant weight: manufacturing operations at risk.

risks.title: Biodiversity and ecosystem impacts from operations
risks.score_rationale: Identified in double materiality (Biodiversity and ecosystems score 3/5). Language of moderate intensity: 'importance of the topic is growing as our maturity and understanding grows'. Trend up with ESG maturity. Moderate but growing weight: manufacturing sites located near sensitive ecosystems.

ai_positioning.summary: Kemira makes no mention of any strategy or AI initiative in its 2023 annual report. Focus is on chemistry, sustainability, and basic digital services.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in the report.
Innovations cited concern biomass polymers and PHA solutions, not AI.
Digital services mentioned remain generic, with no reference to AI.
